description: Read this channel's WhatsApp commerce settings: whether the cart is enabled and whether the catalog is visible in the chat and on the business profile. Returns {data: [one entry]} with is_cart_enabled and is_catalog_visible.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

name: mba_get_commerce_settings

outputSchema.description: WhatsApp commerce settings of the phone number

data.description: Commerce settings of the phone number (one entry)

id.description: ID of the commerce settings object

is_cart_enabled.description: Whether customers can add products to a cart in the chat

is_catalog_visible.description: Whether the catalog is shown in the chat and on the business profile

title: Read commerce settings
